description: Look up what OrbitFour charges and requires for domain extensions (TLDs): standard per-year registration, renewal, transfer and restore prices in USD plus the ICANN fee, the shortest and longest term, the fixed transfer term, whether WHOIS privacy is allowed, any eligibility restriction, whether browsers require HTTPS for its websites (https_required: .app, .dev), and JSON Schemas for what a registration must include (.us, for example, needs Nexus data on the registrant contact). Up to 10 extensions per call; read-only. These are standard prices: when premium_possible is true a particular name can cost more, so quote it with check_domain. An extension OrbitFour does not sell comes back as tld_not_found.
name: get_tld_requirements

constraints.description: Account-wide rules that apply to every TLD.

transfer_lock_days.description: Days after a registration or a completed transfer in during which ICANN's Transfer Policy forbids moving a domain to another registrar (60). One domain's countdown is transfer_lock.days_until_transferable on GET /domains/{id} (get_domain).

oneOf.description: One TLD's catalog entry plus what a registration of it must carry: `registration_schema` for the TLD-specific part of the POST /domains body, `registrant_schema` for the fields the registrant contact needs.

eligibility.description: Who may register a name on this extension.

policy.description: The registry's eligibility policy, when it publishes one.

restricted.description: true when the registry limits who may register: a community or profession, or a connection to a place. Every requires_nexus TLD is restricted, and registrant_schema says what its registrant contact must carry. false: anyone may.

https_required.description: true when browsers load websites on this extension over HTTPS only, because the whole extension is on the HSTS preload list (.app, .dev, .page and others): a site needs a valid TLS certificate before it loads, and http:// links are upgraded. Email and other non-web services are unaffected.

icann_fee.description: Per-year ICANN fee, added on top of each price; "0.00" on a ccTLD, which owes none. check_domain reports the same amount.

period_years.description: The term each price covers: always 1, so every price is per year. A purchase costs it times its years (at least min_years).

premium_possible.description: Whether the registry can price a name above these standard prices; when true, check_domain quotes the name.

registrant_schema.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12); {} when the TLD adds no requirement.

registration.description: Per-year retail price in the catalog's currency, as a decimal string.

registration_schema.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12); {} when the TLD adds no requirement.

renewal.description: Per-year retail price in the catalog's currency, as a decimal string.

restore.description: Per-year retail price in the catalog's currency, as a decimal string.

transfer.description: Per-year retail price in the catalog's currency, as a decimal string.

transfer_years.description: Years a transfer in buys and is charged for, added to the expiry date. A transfer request takes no years: it's always this.

transfer_years_fixed.description: true when the registry accepts exactly transfer_years on a transfer and no other period (PIR's .org: 1); false when transfer_years is this extension's shortest term (min_years).

title: Get an extension's prices and registration rules
